321: ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਤਾ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, they have made the Lord's Name their wealth, by the grace of the perfect Guru. ॥2॥
ਧੋਹੁ. ਨ ਚਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਨਾਲਿ; ਲਬਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ॥
Deceit does not work with the Lord and Master; through greed and attachment, people are ruined.
ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਨਿ ਭਲੇਰਿਆ; ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
Asleep in the intoxication of Maya, they commit evil deeds.
ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ; ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
They are cast into reincarnation again and again, and abandoned on the path of death.
ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਦੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
They receive the fruit of their own deeds, yoked to pain.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ; ਸਭ ਮੰਦੀ ਰੁਤੇ ॥੧੨॥
O Nanak, forgetting the Name, every season is bad. ॥12॥
While standing, sitting and sleeping, there is peace,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਐ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, praising the Name, the mind and body are cooled and soothed. ॥1॥
ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ. ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰੈ; ਸੁਆਰਥੁ. ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Filled with greed, one wanders constantly; no one does what is truly good for them.
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind of one who meets the Guru. ॥2॥
ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਕਉੜੀਆ; ਸਚੇ ਨਾਉ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
All things are bitter; the True Name alone is sweet.
ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ. ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾਂ; ਚਖਿ ਸਾਧੀ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
Those humble servants of the Lord who have tasted it, the holy ones, know its taste.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਮਨਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
It dwells in the mind of the one for whom the Supreme Lord has written it.
ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਭਾਉ ਦੁਯਾ ਕੁਠਾ ॥
The One Immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere, and the love of duality is destroyed.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਦੇਵੈ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧੩॥
Nanak begs the Lord with palms pressed together; God, when pleased, grants it. ॥13॥
ਜਾਚੜੀ ਸਾ ਸਾਰੁ; ਜੋ ਜਾਚੰਦੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
The best prayer is the one that begs for the One Lord.
ਗਾਲੑੀ ਬਿਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ; ਨਾਨਕ ਧਣੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, all other talk is useless, without the Master. ॥1॥
ਨੀਹਿ ਜਿ ਵਿਧਾ ਮੰਨੁ; ਪਛਾਣੂ. ਵਿਰਲੋ ਥਿਓ ॥
Rare is the one who truly knows the Lord, whose mind is pierced by His love.
O Nanak, such a saint unites others with Him, and makes the path smooth and straight. ॥2॥
Serve Him, O my soul, the Giver, the Forgiver.
ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਨਿ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
All sins are destroyed, remembering the Lord of the universe.
ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ. ਸਾਧੂ ਦਸਿਆ; ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ॥
The holy Guru has shown the path to the Lord; chant the Guru's mantra.
ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ॥
All the tastes of Maya become insipid, and the Lord becomes pleasing to the mind.
ਧਿਆਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, meditate on the Transcendent Lord, who has given you life. ॥14॥
ਵਤ ਲਗੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
The season for sowing the True Name has come; whoever sows it eats its fruit.
ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, he alone obtains it, for whom it is so destined. ॥1॥
ਮੰਗਣਾ ਤ ਸਚੁ ਇਕੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
If you must beg, then beg for the One True Name, which the Lord Himself gives when pleased.
ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ. ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
Eating it, the mind is satisfied; O Nanak, it is the Master's gift. ॥2॥
ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੇ ਖਟਹਿ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
They alone earn profit in this world, whose capital is the wealth of the Lord.
ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਸਚੇ ਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
They do not know the love of duality; their hope is in the True One.
ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ; ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
They serve the One, the unchanging Lord; all else is perishable.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
One who forgets the Supreme Lord — every breath they take is in vain.
ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਨ ਰਖਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੧੫॥
He hugs His humble servants close and protects them; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ॥15॥
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ; ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
The Supreme Lord gave the command, and the rain fell of its own accord.
ਅੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਰਜੀ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
Grain and wealth were produced in abundance; the earth was satisfied and fulfilled.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
Forever and ever one sings His praises, and pain and poverty vanish.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
One obtains what is pre-ordained, received in accordance with His will.
The Transcendent Lord has given life; O Nanak, meditate on Him. ॥1॥
322: The state of true life, free of desire, comes from remembering the One alone.
ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ; ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਧੀਰੀਐ ॥
There is no other place; how else can one be comforted?
ਡਿਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨ. ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
I have seen the whole world; without the Name, there is no peace.
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ; ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
Body and wealth will turn to dust; rare is the one who understands this.
ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਬਾਦਿ; ਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥
Colours, forms and pleasures are useless; what are you doing, O mortal?
ਜਿਸੁ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਕਲ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
One whom He Himself leads astray does not know the way to peace.
Those imbued with His love sing of the True Lord, free of desire.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ; ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, they come to the sanctuary of Your door, if they are pleasing to You. ॥2॥
ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ. ਨ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Birth and death do not touch those who hold fast to the hem of the Lord's robe.
ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
They are approved while yet alive, awake in the Lord's praise.
They alone are very fortunate, who have found the company of the holy.
ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ; ਤੂਟੇ ਕਚ ਧਾਗੇ ॥
Forgetting the Name, life is cursed, and breaks like a fragile thread.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਧੂੜਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਾਧ; ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ ॥੧੬॥
O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the holy is more sacred than hundreds of thousands, even millions, of sacred shrines like Prayaag. ॥16॥
ਧਰਣਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੀ, ਖੜ ਰਤਨ ਜੜਾਵੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ, ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
The earth is beautiful, its grass studded with jewels of dew; in the same way the mind is adorned in which the Lord, the Primal Being of love, dwells.
ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੇ ਥੀਏ; ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧॥
All one's affairs become easy, when Guru Nanak, the True Guru, is pleased. ॥1॥
ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਾ; ਜਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
Wandering and wandering in the ten directions, over waters, mountains and forests —
ਜਿਥੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਮਿਰਤਕੋ; ਇਲ ਬਹਿਠੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
wherever the vulture sees a dead body, there it flies down and lands. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਲੋੜੀਅਹਿ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
One who longs for all comforts and rewards should practise Truth.
ਨੇੜੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Behold the Supreme Lord near at hand, and meditate on the One Name.
ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
Become the dust of the feet of all, and merge with the Lord.
ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੀਅ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥
Do not cause any being to suffer, and you shall go to your true home with honour.
ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ. ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਉ ॥੧੭॥
Nanak proclaims the Creator, the Primal Being, the Purifier of sinners. ॥17॥
ਏਕੁ ਜਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
I have made the One my friend; He is all-powerful.
ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਵਥੁ ॥੧॥
My soul is a sacrifice to Him; the Lord is the treasure of my mind and body. ॥1॥
ਜੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੜੇ; ਤੁਧੁ. ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
If You take hold of my hand, O Beloved, I shall never let You go.
ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਨਿ. ਸੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ; ਪੜਹਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਕੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
Those who abandon the Lord are wicked; they fall into the agony of hell. ॥2॥
ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
All treasures are in His home; whatever the Lord does comes to pass.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ; ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
The saints live by chanting and meditating on Him, and He washes away the filth of their sins.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ; ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
His lotus feet dwell in their hearts, and He removes all their troubles.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
One who meets the perfect Guru does not weep in birth and death.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਣੀ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
Nanak has great thirst for the vision of God; in His mercy, He grants it. ॥18॥
ਭੋਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਪਿਰੀ; ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
If you dispel your doubt even a little, and love only the Beloved,
ਜਿਥਹੁ. ਵੰਞੈ ਜਾਇ; ਤਿਥਾਊ. ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
then wherever you go, there you will find Him present. ॥1॥
ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਘੋੜੜੈ, ਕੁੰਦੇ ਪਕੜਹਿ; ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡਾਰੀ ॥
They mount fine horses and grip their guns, yet all they know is the game of stick and ball.
ਹੰਸਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ; ਕੁਕੜ ਦੀ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
They set their hearts on flying with the swans, yet they can only flutter like chickens. ॥2॥
ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ. ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੈ; ਸੋ ਉਧਰੈ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
One who chants the Lord's Name with the tongue and hears it with the ears is saved, my friend.
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ. ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ; ਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
Sacred are the hands that write the Lord's praises with devotion.
ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ; ਸਭਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
It is as if they have bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines and performed all good deeds.
ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੜੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
They are saved from the world-ocean, and have conquered the fortress of Maya.
323: ਨਾਨਕ. ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਦਯੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, serve the infinite Lord, who has attached them to the hem of His robe and saved them. ॥19॥
ਧੰਧੜੇ ਕੁਲਾਹ; ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
Worldly entanglements are ruinous, if the One does not come to mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇਈ ਤੰਨ ਫੁਟੰਨਿ; ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਵਿਸਰੈ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those bodies burst apart, which forget the Master. ॥1॥
The Creator Lord has turned ghosts into angels.
ਸਭੇ ਸਿਖ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
God has saved all His Sikhs and resolved their affairs.
He has seized the false slanderers and thrown them down in His Court.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ; ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Nanak's God is great; He Himself creates and embellishes. ॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ. ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ; ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
God is infinite; He has no limit at all; everything is His doing.
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ; ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਣਾ ॥
The Master is inaccessible and unfathomable, the support of all beings.
ਹਸਤ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ; ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Giving His hand, He protects and cherishes all; He fills and fulfils all.
ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ; ਜਪਿ ਸਚੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
He Himself is merciful and forgiving; chanting the True One, one is saved.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਭਲਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨੦॥
Whatever pleases You is good; slave Nanak seeks Your sanctuary. ॥20॥
ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਖ. ਨ ਕਾ ਰਹੀ; ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
No hunger remains for those who belong to God.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ; ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, all who fall at His feet are saved. ॥1॥
ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
If the beggar begs every day for the Name, the Master accepts the request.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ; ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਭੁਖ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, one whose patron is the Transcendent Lord has no hunger at all. ॥2॥
ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋੜੇ ॥
The mind imbued with the Lord of the universe takes the True Name as its food and clothing.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ; ਏ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ॥
Love for the Lord's Name is its elephants and horses.
ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ. ਖੁਸੀਆ ਘਣੀ; ਧਿਆਇ. ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੇ ॥
Meditating steadily without turning away is its kingdom, property and great joy.
ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਣਾ; ਦਰੁ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋੜੇ ॥
The minstrel begs at God's door and never leaves that door.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ; ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੇ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ
O Nanak, this is the longing of his mind and body: he yearns for God constantly. ॥21॥1॥ Sudh Keeche ॥
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧੪ ॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲਤ; ਰਾਮ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Now I have found the Lord as water to quench the fire burning within me.
ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ; ਤਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
To subdue their minds, some go off to the forests,
ਸੋ ਜਲੁ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
but that water is not found without the Lord God. ॥1॥
ਜਿਹ ਪਾਵਕ; ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਹੈ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
The fire that has consumed angels and mortal beings —
from that burning, the water of the Lord has saved His humble servants. ॥2॥
In the terrifying world-ocean, now become an ocean of peace,
they go on drinking this water, and it never runs out. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord, who holds the bow.
The water of the Lord has quenched my thirst. ॥4॥1॥
ਮਾਧਉ; ਜਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
O Lord, my thirst for Your water does not depart.
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ; ਅਗਨਿ ਉਠੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In that water, the fire of longing has blazed up even more. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ; ਹਉ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨੁ ॥
You are the ocean of water, and I am a fish in that water.
ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ; ਜਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
In the water I live; without the water I perish. ॥1॥
You are the cage, and I am Your little parrot.
So what can the cat of death do to me? ॥2॥
You are the tree, and I am the bird.
How unfortunate I am — I have not yet seen Your vision. ॥3॥
324: You are the True Guru, and I am Your new disciple.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਿਲੁ; ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Says Kabeer, meet me — this is the very last moment. ॥4॥2॥
ਜਬ ਹਮ; ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
When I realised that there is only the One Lord,
I am without honour; I have lost my honour.
ਹਮਰੈ ਖੋਜਿ; ਪਰਹੁ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Let no one follow in my footsteps. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I am bad, bad within my own mind.
I have no dealings with anyone. ॥2॥
ਪਤਿ ਅਪਤਿ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
I have no shame about honour or dishonour.
You shall know, when your own pretence is exposed. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, honour is that which is accepted by the Lord.
Give up everything, and meditate on the Lord alone. ॥4॥3॥
If union with God could be obtained by wandering naked,
ਬਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
then all the deer of the forest would be liberated. ॥1॥
What does it matter whether one goes naked or wears a deerskin,
ਜਬ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਸਿ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if one does not recognise the Lord within the soul? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If spiritual perfection could be obtained by shaving the head,
why have no sheep found liberation? ॥2॥
If one could be saved by celibacy, O brother,
ਖੁਸਰੈ ਕਿਉ ਨ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
why has a eunuch not obtained the supreme state? ॥3॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
without the Lord's Name, who has ever found salvation? ॥4॥4॥
Those who take their ritual baths in the evening and the morning
are like frogs in the water. ॥1॥
ਜਉ ਪੈ; ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
When people have no love for the Lord's Name,
ਤੇ ਸਭਿ; ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
they must all go to the Righteous Judge. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who love their bodies and put on all sorts of guises
ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ; ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
do not feel compassion, even in dreams. ॥2॥
Many clever people recite the four Vedas,
but only the holy find peace in this ocean of the Dark Age. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, why do so many rituals?
Renounce everything, and drink in the supreme essence of the Lord. ॥4॥5॥
ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ. ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ; ਕਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
What use is chanting, what use is penance, fasting or worship,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
to one whose heart is filled with the love of duality? ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਜਨ; ਮਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
O humble being, link your mind to the Lord.
Through cleverness, the four-armed Lord is not obtained. ॥ Rahao ॥
Give up greed and putting on a show for others.
Give up lust, anger and ego. ॥2॥
Performing rituals, people are bound in ego;
Says Kabeer, He is obtained only through devotional worship.
Through simple innocence, the Lord is met. ॥4॥6॥
ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸ ਮਹਿ; ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
In the dwelling of the womb, there is no ancestry or caste.
All have originated from the seed of God. ॥1॥
ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ; ਬਾਮਨ ਕਬ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ॥
Tell me, O Pandit, since when have you been a Brahmin?
ਬਾਮਨ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ; ਜਨਮੁ ਮਤ ਖੋਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Do not waste your life by repeatedly claiming to be a Brahmin. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If you are indeed a Brahmin, born of a Brahmin mother,
ਤਉ ਆਨ ਬਾਟ; ਕਾਹੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
then why did you not come by some other way? ॥2॥
ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ; ਹਮ ਕਤ ਸੂਦ ॥
How is it that you are a Brahmin, and I am of low status?
ਹਮ ਕਤ ਲੋਹੂ; ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਦੂਧ ॥੩॥
How is it that I am formed of blood, and you are made of milk? ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, one who contemplates God
is said to be a Brahmin among us. ॥4॥7॥
325: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ; ਸੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
In the darkness of ignorance, no one can ever sleep in peace.
ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਦੋਊ; ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
The king and the pauper both weep and cry. ॥1॥
ਜਉ ਪੈ; ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਕਹਿਬੋ ॥
So long as the tongue does not chant the Lord's Name,
one keeps on coming and going in reincarnation, crying out in pain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
It is like the shade of a tree, as one sees it;
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਏ; ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
when the breath of life leaves, tell me, whose is the wealth of Maya then? ॥2॥
As the music merges back into the instrument,
ਮੂਏ ਮਰਮੁ; ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
how can anyone know the secret of the dead? ॥3॥
Like the swan hovering over the lake, death hovers over the body.
Drink in the sublime elixir of the Lord, O Kabeer. ॥4॥8॥
ਜੋਤਿ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ; ਜਾਤਿ ਕੀ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
The creation is born of the Light, and the Light is in the creation.
It bears two fruits: false glass and true pearls. ॥1॥
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ; ਜੋ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Where is that home which is said to be free of fear,
ਭਉ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਇ; ਅਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
where fear flees and one lives without fear? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
On the banks of sacred rivers and at pilgrimage places, the mind is not appeased.
People remain entangled in good and bad deeds. ॥2॥
Sin and virtue are both the same.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ; ਤਜਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਆਨ ॥੩॥
In the home of your own being is the philosopher's stone; renounce your search for any other virtue. ॥3॥
Kabeer: O mortal, do not lose the Name of the Lord, beyond all qualities.
Engage your mind in it, and remain absorbed in it. ॥4॥9॥
Those who claim to know the Lord, who is beyond measure and beyond thought,
I do not know where heaven is.
ਜਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ; ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Everyone claims that they are going there. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By mere talk, the mind is not appeased.
ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਹਉਮੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
The mind is appeased only when ego is conquered. ॥2॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਮਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
As long as the mind is filled with the desire for heaven,
ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ. ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
one does not dwell at the Lord's feet. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, unto whom should I tell this?
The company of the holy is heaven. ॥4॥10॥
We are conceived, we grow, and having grown, we pass away.
Before our very eyes, this world is passing away. ॥1॥
ਲਾਜ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ; ਕਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
How can you not die of shame, claiming this world as your own?
ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ; ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
At the very last moment, nothing is yours. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Trying various methods, you cherish your body,
but at the time of death, it is burnt in the fire. ॥2॥
You apply perfume and sandalwood oil to your limbs,
ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ; ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
but that body is burnt with the firewood. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, listen, O virtuous people:
your beauty shall vanish, as the whole world watches. ॥4॥11॥
Why mourn when someone else dies?
Do so only if you yourself are to live forever. ॥1॥
I shall not die as the rest of the world dies,
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਹੈ; ਜੀਆਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for now I have met the Life-giving Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
People perfume their bodies with fragrant oils,
and in those pleasures, they forget the Lord of supreme bliss. ॥2॥
There is one well, and five water-carriers.
Even though the rope is broken, the foolish ones keep trying to draw water. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this understanding:
there is no well, and no water-carrier. ॥4॥12॥
The unmoving and the moving creatures, insects and moths —
in numerous lifetimes, I have passed through these many forms. ॥1॥
326: I have lived in many such homes,
ਜਬ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ; ਗਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, before I came into the womb this time. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I was a Yogi, a celibate, a penitent and a Brahmchaaree.
Sometimes I was a king sitting on a throne, and sometimes I was a beggar. ॥2॥
The faithless cynics shall die, while the saints shall all live.
They drink in the Lord's sublime elixir with their tongues. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, O God, have mercy on me.
I am so tired; now, please bless me with Your perfection. ॥4॥13॥
ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੈ; ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Mistaking it for cream, people churn water. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The donkey grazes on the green grass;
rising each day, it laughs and brays, and then dies. ॥1॥
The bull is intoxicated, and runs around wildly.
He romps and grazes, and then falls into hell. ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, a strange sport has become manifest:
the sheep is sucking the milk of her lamb. ॥3॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, my intellect is enlightened.
Says Kabeer, the Guru has blessed me with this understanding. ॥4॥1॥14॥
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਛੋਡਿ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
Like a fish out of water,
ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ; ਹਉ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
I am without the penance of past lives, so people say. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ; ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
Now tell me, Lord, what will be my condition?
ਤਜੀ ਲੇ ਬਨਾਰਸ; ਮਤਿ ਭਈ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I left Benares — have I lost my senses? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I have wasted my whole life in the city of Shiva;
at the time of my death, I have moved to Magahar. ॥2॥
For many years, I practised penance at Kaashi;
now that my time to die has come, I have come to dwell at Magahar! ॥3॥
Kaashi and Magahar — I consider them one and the same.
With such shallow devotion, how will I cross over? ॥4॥
ਕਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਜ ਸਿਵ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Says Kabeer, everyone knows Ganesha's guru, Shiva,
but Kabeer has died chanting the Lord's Name. ॥5॥15॥
You may apply sandalwood oil and perfume to your limbs,
ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ; ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
but that body shall be burnt with the firewood. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ; ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
Why should anyone take pride in this body or wealth?
ਧਰਨਿ ਪਰੈ; ਉਰਵਾਰਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They shall lie on the ground; they shall not go along with you to the world beyond. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ; ਦਿਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਮ ॥
Those who sleep by night and work by day
ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ; ਲੇਹਿ ਨ. ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
do not chant the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ॥2॥
ਹਾਥਿ ਤ ਡੋਰ; ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇਓ ਤੰਬੋਰ ॥
They hold the falcon's string in their hands and chew betel leaves in their mouths,
but at the time of death, they shall be tied up tightly, like thieves. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
One who, through the Guru's teachings, sings the Lord's praises with great delight
finds peace, dwelling on the Lord alone. ॥4॥
In His mercy, He implants the Name within;
He makes the sweet fragrance of the Lord, Har, Har, dwell there. ॥5॥
Says Kabeer, remember Him, O blind fool!
The Lord is true; all worldly affairs are false. ॥6॥16॥
ਜਮ ਤੇ ਉਲਟਿ; ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Turning away from death, I have turned to the Lord.
Pain has been eliminated, and I dwell in peace and comfort.
My enemies have been transformed into friends.
The faithless cynics have been transformed into good-hearted people. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ; ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Now, I feel that everything brings me peace.
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ; ਜਬ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Peace and tranquillity have come, since I realised the Lord of the universe. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
327: My body was afflicted with millions of diseases.
They have been transformed into the peaceful, calm concentration of Samaadhi.
When one understands one's own self,
one no longer suffers from illness and the three fevers. ॥2॥
My mind has now turned back, and become one with the Eternal Lord.
I have come to know this only now, having died while yet alive.
Says Kabeer, I am now immersed in intuitive peace and poise.
ਆਪਿ ਨ ਡਰਉ; ਨ ਅਵਰ ਡਰਾਵਉ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
I do not fear anyone, nor do I strike fear into anyone else. ॥3॥17॥
ਪਿੰਡਿ ਮੂਐ; ਜੀਉ. ਕਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
When the body dies, where does the soul go?
It is absorbed into the untouched, unstruck melody of the Word.
Only one who knows the Lord realises Him.
The mind is satisfied, like the mute who eats the sugar candy and simply smiles. ॥1॥
Such is the spiritual wisdom which the Lord imparts.
ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ; ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, hold your breath steady within the central channel of the Sushmanaa. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Adopt such a Guru, that you shall not have to adopt another again.
ਸੋ ਪਦੁ ਰਵਹੁ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਰਵਨਾ ॥
Dwell in such a state, that you shall never have to dwell in any other.
ਸੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹੁ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
Embrace such a meditation, that you shall never have to embrace any other.
ਐਸੇ ਮਰਹੁ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
Die in such a way, that you shall never have to die again. ॥2॥
I have turned my mind back, uniting the Ganges with the Jamuna within.
ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸੰਗਮ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੑਾਵਉ ॥
Without water, I bathe at the confluence within my mind.
To look upon all with an impartial eye — let this be your daily occupation.
Contemplate this essence of reality — what else is there to contemplate? ॥3॥
Water, fire, wind, earth and ether —
adopt such a way of life and you shall be close to the Lord.
Says Kabeer, I meditate on the Immaculate Lord,
ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ; ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
and I have reached that home from which I shall not have to come back again. ॥4॥18॥
The Lord cannot be obtained by weighing out one's weight in gold.
ਮਨੁ ਦੇ; ਰਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ਹੈ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
I have bought the Lord by giving Him my mind. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ; ਰਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Now I recognise that the Lord is my own.
ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind is intuitively pleased with Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Brahma spoke of Him continually, but could not find His limit.
Because of my devotion to the Lord, He has come to sit within the home of my heart. ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, I have given up my restless intellect.
Devotional worship of the Lord alone is my destiny. ॥3॥1॥19॥
That death which terrifies the whole world —
the nature of that death has been revealed to me, through the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਰਉ; ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Now, how shall I die? My mind has already accepted death.
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ; ਜਿਨ. ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who do not know the Lord die over and over again. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Everyone says, "I will die, I will die."
But he alone becomes immortal, who dies with intuitive understanding. ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, my mind is filled with bliss;
my doubts have been dispelled, and I am in supreme ecstasy. ॥3॥20॥
ਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰ; ਮੂਲੁ ਕਤ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
There is no special place where the soul is hurt; where should I apply the ointment?
ਖੋਜਤ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ; ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
I have searched the body, but I have not found such a place. ॥1॥
Only one who has felt the pain of such love knows it;
the arrows of the Lord's devotional worship are so sharp! ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I look upon all His soul-brides with an equal eye;
how can I know which ones are dear to the Husband Lord? ॥2॥
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Says Kabeer, one who has such destiny written on her forehead —
ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੩॥੨੧॥
her Husband Lord turns away all others, and meets with her. ॥3॥21॥
328: ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਭਾਈ ॥
One who has the Lord as their Master, O brother —
countless liberations knock at their door. ॥1॥
If I say now that my trust is in You alone, Lord,
ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾ; ਕਵਨੁ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
then what obligation do I have to anyone else? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਹਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
He bears the burden of the three worlds;
why should He not cherish you too? ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding:
ਕਿਆ ਬਸੁ; ਜਉ. ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੨॥
if the mother herself poisons her child, what can anyone do? ॥3॥22॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤ; ਸਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Without truth, how can a woman be a true, chaste wife?
O Pandit, look and contemplate this within your heart. ॥1॥
Without love, how can affection grow?
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਸੁ; ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As long as there is attachment to pleasure, there can be no love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who believes Maya to be true in his own soul
ਸੋ ਰਮਯੇ ਕਉ; ਮਿਲੈ ਨ. ਸੁਪਨੈ ॥੨॥
does not meet the Lord, even in dreams. ॥2॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
She who surrenders her body, mind, wealth, home and self —
she is the happy soul-bride, says Kabeer. ॥3॥23॥
The whole world is engrossed in corruption.
This corruption has drowned entire families. ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਨਰ; ਨਾਵ ਚਉੜਿ ਕਤ ਬੋੜੀ ॥
O man, why have you wrecked your boat on dry land?
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਤੋੜਿ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋੜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You have broken with the Lord, and joined hands with corruption. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Angels and humans alike are burning in the raging fire.
ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨੀਰੁ; ਪਸੁ. ਪੀਵਸਿ ਨ ਝਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
The water is close at hand, but the beast does not make the effort to drink it. ॥2॥
By constant remembrance, the water is brought forth.
That water is immaculate and pure, says Kabeer. ॥3॥24॥
ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲਿ ਪੂਤੁ; ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
That family, whose son has no spiritual wisdom or contemplation —
why did his mother not just become a widow? ॥1॥
ਜਿਹ ਨਰ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨਹਿ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
That man who has not practised devotional worship of the Lord —
ਜਨਮਤ; ਕਸ. ਨ ਮੁਓ, ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
why did such a sinful man not die at birth? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੁਚੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰਭ ਗਏ; ਕੀਨ ਬਚਿਆ ॥
So many pregnancies end in miscarriage — why was this one spared?
He lives his life in this world like a deformed amputee. ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, however beautiful one may look,
without the Name, one is ugly and deformed. ॥3॥25॥
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੇਹਿ; ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Those humble beings who chant the Name of their Lord and Master —
I am forever a sacrifice to them. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
He who sings the pure praises of the Lord is pure,
ਸੋ ਭਾਈ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and that brother is dear to my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those hearts within which the Lord is fully pervading —
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ; ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
I am the dust of their lotus feet. ॥2॥
I am a weaver by caste, but patient of mind.
Slowly, steadily, Kabeer chants the Lord's glorious virtues. ॥3॥26॥
From the tenth gate, my furnace, the sweet nectar trickles down.
ਸੰਚਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਤਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਾਠੀ ॥੧॥
I have collected this supreme essence, and my body has become the firewood. ॥1॥
He alone is called intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise,
ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ; ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who drinks in the essence of the Lord's Name, through contemplation of spiritual wisdom. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the barmaid of intuitive poise comes to meet me,
I pass my days and nights intoxicated with bliss. ॥2॥
Coming to know Him, I have attached my consciousness to the Immaculate Lord,
and then, says Kabeer, I obtained the inner light that is beyond fear. ॥3॥27॥
The inclination of the mind pervades the whole mind;
329: so what spiritual attainment is there in killing the mind? ॥1॥
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਨਿ; ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Who is that silent sage, who has killed his mind?
ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By killing the mind, tell me, who is saved? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Everyone speaks as the mind within prompts them;
ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
without subduing the mind, devotional worship is not performed. ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, one who knows this secret
beholds within their own mind the Lord of the three worlds. ॥3॥28॥
The stars which are seen in the sky —
who is the painter who painted them? ॥1॥
ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ; ਅੰਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Tell me, O Pandit, what is the sky attached to?
Very fortunate is the knower who knows this. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The sun and the moon give their light;
Says Kabeer, he alone knows this,
whose heart is filled with the Lord, and whose mouth is also filled with the Lord. ॥3॥29॥
The Simritee is the daughter of the Vedas, O brother.
She has brought a chain and a rope. ॥1॥
She has imprisoned the people in her own city.
ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਫਾਧਿ; ਕਾਲ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
She has tightened the noose of emotional attachment and shot the arrow of death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਟੀ ਨ ਕਟੈ; ਤੂਟਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
By cutting, she cannot be cut, and she cannot be broken.
ਸਾ ਸਾਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ; ਜਗ ਕਉ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
She has become a serpent, and she is eating the world. ॥2॥
ਹਮ ਦੇਖਤ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
Before my very eyes, she has plundered the whole world.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ; ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੦॥
Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, I have escaped her. ॥3॥30॥
I have grasped the reins and attached the bridle;
with the saddle of all-pervading awareness, I ride my horse through the realm of the Formless Lord. ॥1॥
Let us ride the horse of self-reflection,
ਸਹਜ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੜੈ; ਪਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and place our feet in the stirrups of intuitive poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚਲੁ ਰੇ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ; ਤੁਝਹਿ ਲੇ ਤਾਰਉ ॥
Come, O horse of my mind, let me take you to heaven.
ਹਿਚਹਿ ਤ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਮਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
If you refuse, I shall strike you with the whip of love. ॥2॥
remain detached from the Vedas and the Semitic scriptures. ॥3॥31॥
That mouth which used to eat the five delicacies —
I have seen the flames being applied to that mouth. ॥1॥
ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ; ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
O Lord, my King, please rid me of this one affliction:
ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ; ਅਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the burning in the fire of desire, and dwelling again in the womb. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The body is destroyed in so many ways;
ਕੋ ਜਾਰੇ; ਕੋ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
some burn it, and some bury it in the earth. ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, O Lord, please reveal Your lotus feet to me;
ਪਾਛੈ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ; ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥੩੨॥
after that, go ahead and send me to my death. ॥3॥32॥
He Himself is the fire, and He Himself is the wind.
When our Lord and Master burns someone, who can save them? ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ; ਤਨੁ ਜਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Let the body burn, if it must, while one chants the Lord's Name;
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the consciousness remains absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾ ਕੋ ਜਰੈ; ਕਾਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਨਿ ॥
Who is burnt, and who suffers loss?
The Lord who holds the bow plays like a juggler in his many guises. ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, utter just these two words:
if He is your Lord and Master, He will protect you. ॥3॥33॥
ਨਾ ਮੈ; ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
I have not attached my mind to Yogic meditation;
without detachment, one cannot escape from Maya. ॥1॥
How can I live a true life,
330: ਜਬ ਨ ਹੋਇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when I do not have the support of the Lord's Name? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Says Kabeer, I have searched the heavens,
and have not seen any other equal to the Lord. ॥2॥34॥
ਜਿਹ ਸਿਰਿ; ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਬਾਧਤ ਪਾਗ ॥
That head which was once embellished with the finest turban —
upon that head, the crows now clean their beaks. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੋ; ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਈਆ ॥
What pride should we take in this body and wealth?
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Why not hold tight to the Lord's Name instead? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Says Kabeer, listen, O my mind:
this may be your fate as well! ॥2॥35॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
People beg for pleasure, but pain comes instead.
ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ; ਹਮਹੁ. ਨ ਮਾਂਗਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
I would rather not beg for that pleasure. ॥1॥
People are still involved in corruption, yet they hope for pleasure.
ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
How will they find their home in the Sovereign Lord? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ; ਸਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਡਰਾਨਾ ॥
Even Shiva and Brahma are afraid of this pleasure,
ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ; ਹਮਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
but I have judged that pleasure to be true. ॥2॥
Even sages like Sanak and Naarad, and the thousand-headed serpent,
ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ; ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
did not see the mind within the body. ॥3॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Anyone can search for this mind, O brother:
when it escapes from the body, where does it go? ॥4॥
By the Guru's grace, Jai Dayv and Naam Dayv
ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ; ਇਨ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੫॥
came to know this, through loving devotional worship of the Lord. ॥5॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਨਹੀ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
This mind does not come and go,
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
for one whose doubt is dispelled, and who has realised the Truth. ॥6॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
This mind has no form or outline.
By God's command it was created; understanding God's command, it shall be absorbed into Him again. ॥7॥
ਇਸ ਮਨ ਕਾ; ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Whoever knows the secret of this mind
is absorbed through this mind into the Lord, the Giver of peace. ॥8॥
There is One soul, and it pervades all bodies;
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੯॥੧॥੩੬॥
Those who remain awake, day and night, in the One Name —
ਕੇਤਕ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ; ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
many of them have become perfect, with their consciousness attuned to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The seekers, the adepts and all the silent sages have lost the game.
The One Name is the wish-fulfilling tree, which saves them and carries them across. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ; ਸੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ. ਆਨਾ ॥
Those who are dyed in the Lord do not belong to any other.
Says Kabeer, they have realised the Name of the Lord. ॥2॥37॥
ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਿਲਜ; ਲਾਜ ਤੋੁਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
O shameless soul, are you not ashamed?
ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ; ਕਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Forsaking the Lord, where and to whom will you go? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One whose Lord and Master is the highest of all —
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਤ. ਨ ਸੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
it is not proper for him to go to the house of another. ॥1॥
That Lord and Master is pervading everywhere.
The Lord is always with us; He is never far away. ॥2॥
ਕਵਲਾ; ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
Even Maya, the goddess of wealth, takes refuge at His feet.
ਕਹੁ ਜਨ; ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
Tell me, what is not in His home? ॥3॥
ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ; ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Everyone speaks of Him; He is all-powerful,
ਸੋ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ; ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
He is His own Master, the Giver. ॥4॥
Says Kabeer, he alone is perfect in this world,
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੩੮॥
in whose heart there is none other than the Lord. ॥5॥38॥
